title: F10ProductContributionConfig
description: Validation schema for F10 Product Contribution v2 Configuration

api_version.description: Pinned Shopify Admin GraphQL API version

as_of.description: Explicit evaluation date (YYYY-MM-DD); never uses system clock

currency_minor_units.description: Minor currency precision (e.g. 2 for USD, 0 for JPY, 3 for BHD)

return_window_days.description: Customer return policy window in days

processing_days.description: Warehouse and carrier processing days required for return inspection

carrier_cost_model.description: Courier outbound shipping cost resolution model

carrier_flat_rate.description: Flat courier cost per shipment if carrier_cost_model is flat

return_ship_cost.description: Reverse logistics courier cost per physical return (Tier T2)

handling_cost.description: Warehouse handling / restocking labor cost per return (Tier T2)

pick_pack_cost.description: Optional outbound pick and pack fee per fulfilled unit

fee_fallback.description: Gateway fee model when transaction fee array is missing

shipping_alloc_fallback.description: Fallback method when line weight is missing across order lines

goodwill_rule.description: Attribution method for order adjustments without line items (Decision D3)

max_unknown_cost_share.description: Maximum tolerated share of revenue with unknown COGS before marking UNSCOREABLE

min_units_for_confidence.description: Minimum sold units required to avoid LOW_CONFIDENCE flag

healthy_margin_by_category.description: Baseline healthy margin threshold per standardized category

category_map.description: Mapping from productType to standardized category

return_rate_baseline_by_category.description: Expected baseline return rate by category for defect signal detection

bundle_policy.description: Handling of bundled product lines (Decision D5)

cost_snapshot_policy.description: Handling of historical orders lacking point-in-time cost snapshot (Decision D12)

reconcile_tolerance.description: Allowed numerical drift tolerance in reconciliation gates
